observed_result.summary: m02-plan §3: every M02 exit case per platform, all rows from one build.

limitations: Status discipline (m02-plan, M01 rule E15): verified rows mean the required tests ran and passed on that platform in this run; not an independent review of the units.

Linux binaries are cross-built on the macOS host with zig and run natively on the devbox; the one build-host-path test (heimdall_testkit-unit repo::tests::unset_or_empty_is_the_compile_time_root, case-index build_host_paths, neutral) runs on the build host only.

Windows runs in local mode by an agent on the PC (no remote route into WSL; ADR-0007 §12.32 item 15): the agent's environment starts processes with Ctrl-C ignored, recorded as ctrl-c-inherited=ignored; the pseudoconsole driver enables Ctrl-C processing for the heimdall it creates (§12.44 item 2). An interactive console operator (B5) is still an owner input.
Proptest regression files resolve at compile-time source paths: persisted regression seeds replay on macOS only; the fixed default seeds run everywhere.

Every fixture is disposable: per-run keys, the loopback fixture sshd, disposable ssh-agents with a scratch HOME, scratch configuration, a disposable WSL distribution; the owners' keys, agents, ~/.ssh and Git configuration are never test material (m02-plan §0; ADR-0007 §9).
